subject: Hosted API pricing qualification - token volumes & peak TPS
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finstream.ai>
Cc: Laura Kim <laura@finstream.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + numbers request - Hosted API pricing qualification

Hi Samir / Laura,

Thanks again for taking the time today - great conversation and really appreciate the level of detail on your workflows. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get you a concrete hosted pricing estimate: 

- Use case: user-facing personalization + scheduled batch enrichment (both generate+prompting)
- Primary SLA: sub-300ms p50 for user flows; batch can be async
- Security: standard SOC2 controls required (you mentioned compliance team will follow up)

Action items for you (just need ballpark numbers to model unit economics):
1) Expected steady-state monthly token volume (total tokens / month)
2) Expected peak TPS (requests per second) during peak 95th percentile
3) Any hard budget range for hosted API (ARR / 12 or annual committed spend)
4) Typical sequence lengths (avg prompt tokens / avg completion tokens) and percent split of prompt vs completion tokens if you have it

I'm attaching a one-page hosted pricing explainer. If you can reply with rough numbers today/tomorrow we'll run an initial cost model and propose 2 options: a committed hosted plan and a cost/latency optimized plan (batching + KV caching).

Thanks!
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_hosted_pricing_v1.pdf

From: Samir Patel <samir@finstream.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Kim <laura@finstream.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:13:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + numbers request - Hosted API pricing qualification

Hi Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. Confirming numbers from our side (these are ballpark but represent production expectations):

- Expected steady-state monthly tokens: 350,000,000 tokens / month (we expect ramp from a 100M pilot over 2 quarters)
- Peak TPS (95p): ~18-20 TPS (spikes during morning reconciliation + heavy user sessions)
- Average TPS (steady): ~3 TPS
- Typical lengths: avg prompt 120 tokens, avg completion 240 tokens (approx 1:2 prompt:completion by tokens)
- Budget (guidance): $150k-300k / year for hosted API (we're flexible for a committed/discounted program if unit economics make sense)
- Target cost target: ideally ~ $300 / 1M tokens (this is our internal target to make ops + unit economics work)

We also have two technical constraints to flag: TLS MITM inspection will be required for a pilot region, and the compliance team will want SOC2 evidence + data residency info (US). Laura will coordinate the security questionnaire.

Happy to jump on a short technical call next week with Alex to share traffic patterns and sample logs.

- Samir
Head of Platform, FinStream
samir@finstream.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finstream.ai>
Cc: Laura Kim <laura@finstream.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + numbers request - Hosted API pricing qualification

Samir - this is great, thanks for the detail. A few quick notes + next steps from our side:

- Numbers look reasonable and actionable - we'll run two scenarios: committed hosted pricing (discounted per-1M token tiers) and a usage-first plan optimized with batching + KV caching to get to closer to your $/1M target. We'll share the calculator (attached) with line items for caching, batching, and expected savings.
- Compliance: we'll surface SOC2 docs and a short data-residency note; our solution supports US-only regions and KMS integrations (I attached the proposed SLA doc).
- Technical deep-dive: Alex (cc'd) can run a short session to validate peak TPS patterns and sequence lengths - that will help us size concurrency and caching needs.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) We'll send a preliminary hosted cost model (Marissa) by EOD PT today based on the 350M token volume + peak 20 TPS.
2) Alex to schedule a tech deep-dive for next week (30-45 minutes) to validate traffic pattern and sequence lengths.
3) Laura to share the security questionnaire link when ready; we'll pull SOC2 evidence in parallel.

Attaching: redwood_pricing_calc.xlsx and proposed_sla.pdf. If this looks good I'll also include a 60-90 day pilot proposal that includes a small committed discount to accelerate the POC.

Thanks - talk soon.
Marissa

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finstream.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Kim <laura@finstream.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + numbers request - Hosted API pricing qualification

Thanks all - I'll schedule the technical deep-dive. Proposed slots: Thu 03 Dec 11:00-11:45 PT or Fri 04 Dec 09:00-09:45 PT. Please reply with preferred slot and any sample traffic files you can share (one-day trace or one-week aggregate).

Quick list of items we'll validate on the call:
- Peak TPS shape (sustained vs short burst)
- Concurrency needs (avg open KV cache sessions)
- Max sequence lengths and distribution (we'll size GPU memory and batching windows)
- Any special latency SLO for interactive flows (p50/p95 target)

P.S. Marissa - I used the numbers Samir sent and started a baseline cost run in the attached calc. We should be able to present two clear options in the follow-up: committed-hosted and cost-optimized-hosted.

- Alex
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
